title: Launch compact gate severity reset
summary: Reset the Launch compact gate presentation scale so missing or unloaded evidence is neutral, backend review evidence is orange, backend rejection or active work is red, and fully clear required evidence is green.
reason: Operators need the compact launch strip to communicate likely outcome rather than general caution. Unknown, stale, no-history, or not-loaded evidence should not look like a likely failure, but green must remain reserved for clear required evidence.
behavior_before: The Launch compact gate rendered unknown, not loaded, no history, and incomplete evidence as review/orange, so the strip looked alarmist even when nothing concrete was likely to go wrong.
behavior_after: The Launch compact gate renders unknown or missing evidence as neutral Needs Evidence, review evidence as At Risk, backend rejection or active work as Will Fail, and required ready evidence as All Clear/OK. The Last history gate remains advisory and does not degrade required gate status when it only has no history.
